name: Ledger & Co.
description: Crisp accounting firm site for small businesses and freelancers with a scroll-drawn results chart and a live tax-savings estimate calculator.
features: Bar and line chart that draws itself as it scrolls into view
Interactive savings estimator with smoothly tweening numbers and a clear disclaimer
Three fixed monthly pricing plans with a highlighted favourite
Process steps, client stories, FAQ and free-call booking form
signature: Quarterly results chart grows and draws on scroll; the savings calculator tweens every figure as you move the sliders
